fromStream()

The fromStream() method performs a stream-driven state update on a FeatureCell. It subscribes to an Observable source and forwards each emitted value into the pipeline as a discrete state update.

Unlike replaceState() and mergeState(), which perform single execution updates, fromStream() establishes a long-lived subscription that may produce multiple pipeline executions over time.

Method Contract Summary

  • Must be called after initialize()
  • Subscribes to an Observable<T>
  • Each emission triggers a merge-style pipeline execution
  • Stream errors are converted to VaultError and submitted as state
  • Automatically unsubscribes when the FeatureCell is destroyed
  • Returns void
Note

fromStream() does not commit state directly. Each emitted value is forwarded to mergeState(), where it enters the full pipeline and is processed through Resolve, operators, filters, reducers, and taps before final commitment in the State stage.

 Subscribes to an observable source and forwards each emitted value into the pipeline via mergeState(). Each emission produces a discrete pipeline execution.
Options
Option Description
autoResetError: boolean When true (default), clears any existing error before forwarding the incoming value. When false, existing error state is preserved unless explicitly overridden.

Stream emissions always forward values using merge semantics. Replace semantics are not used by fromStream().

Execution Model

Each next emission from the source observable produces a new candidate state submission through mergeState().

  • next → forwarded as {{ `{ value }` }}
  • error → converted to VaultError and forwarded as {{ `{ error }` }}
  • complete → ingress marked complete (no automatic state mutation)

Subscriptions are automatically bound to the FeatureCell lifecycle and are terminated when the cell is destroyed.

Example

The fromStream() method connects an observable source directly to the pipeline. Each emission produces a deterministic pipeline execution and final state snapshot.

What this does

  • Subscribes to a stream
  • Forwards each value via mergeState()
  • Processes through the full pipeline
  • Commits a new immutable snapshot per emission

Note

fromStream() does not replace state directly. It delegates to mergeState() for each emission. The active Merge behavior determines how values are structurally combined with existing committed state.
